pole_plus.label: Copy-ahead inside repeated structured records: deep in a list of similar records (citations, code rows, tables, logs, configs), fires on a token whose next token is the template's recurring text already seen in earlier records; grows with record count; needs the earlier copy; weak for repeated prose, silent for a single repeated name.

pole_minus.label: Segment end with little established context: strongest at the line break ending a short heading/title/caption/credit line (no closing punctuation) at a fresh section or document start; offshoots on phrase-final words and sentence ends early in a text and field ends in record lists; quiet in formulaic predictable sequences.
